name: spells
_comment: Battle effects for additive blending: two one-shot spells and a big summon blast. Authored: written with Claude (Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5).

effects.name: fire
effects.subject: a burst of orange and yellow flames erupting upward
effects.motion: the flames burst upward and flicker, embers fly off, then the fire dies down

effects.name: ice
effects.subject: a cluster of sharp pale blue ice crystals forming
effects.motion: sharp ice crystals grow outward from the center and sparkle, frost mist swirls

effects.name: summon_magma_burst
effects.subject: a huge eruption of molten orange magma and bright brass sparks
effects.motion: molten magma erupts upward and outward in a wide blast, brass sparks fly, then it settles
